$comment: The Human Archive as it stood at main@a6a377a, extracted programmatically from that commit rather than retyped. AC-7.1 requires the four entries' quotes, locations and archive numbers to be PRESERVED through this restructure — so the criterion needs a record of what they were, taken from before the work started. Only `image` was allowed to change (from a Lovable pointer's .url to a real file import), which is why it is absent here: pinning it would pin the bug.
